sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Die-Struck Brass Cloisonné Polishing of Novelty Enamel Badges

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law with strong commercial law influence
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Tax Information Exchange Agreements and Double Tax Treaties in force (e.g., Mexico, Netherlands, UAE, Qatar, Singapore, Luxembourg)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 23 of 2015 (AML/CFT regime), as amended by Law 23 of 2019 and Executive Decree 29 of 2016; Law 52 of 2016 (Beneficial Ownership Registry, as amended by Law 68 of 2017 and Law 70 of 2019); Resolution No. 21 of 2021 (Registro Público de Panamá beneficial ownership filing standards); Uniform Commercial Registry Law ( Ley 32 de 1927 and its reforms); Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores guidelines; SSRF (Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros) supervisory regulations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (Certificado de Inscripción / Acta de Constitución based on Escritura Pública)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Panama (for foreign use)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized and legalized Power of Attorney (Poder) if representation or signing authority is delegated
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of Panama or Panamanian Consulate abroad
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization for foreign-notarized documents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the Articles of Incorporation (Estatutos / Pacto Social) with all amendments
Good Standing Certificate / Certificado de Vigencia
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by Ministry of Foreign Affairs

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence for all UBOs and directors against OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, UK HM Treasury sanctions list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and Panama's national list from the Financial Analysis Unit (UAF). PEP status must be determined for all foreign and domestic politically exposed persons; including their family members and close associates. Screening must be performed prior to onboarding, and continuous monitoring through a risk-based approach under Law 23 of 2015 and SSRF guidance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Sistema de Consulta de Nombre (https://www.panama.registropublico.gob.pa) and Sede Electrónica de la Dirección General del Registro Público
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in Spanish or the Latin alphabet; the name may include numerals, but all non-Spanish alphabets must be transliterated to Latin script. The legal form indicator 'Sociedad Anónima' or 'S.A.' is required. The name must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered entity, and must be compatible with official registry language and legal form requirements.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected name may be appealed by submitting a written request (recurso de reconsideración) to the Registro Público de Panamá within 5 business days of notification, followed by an administrative appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Director General or the superior authority if still denied. No extension is permitted beyond the statutory 30-day reservation; if the name expires, a fresh application is required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are permissible as registered agent addresses for incorporation purposes, but for e-commerce operations (Etsy/Stripe) and banking, a physical operating address may be required. The Public Registry accepts a registered agent's physical Panamanian address; virtual office-only arrangements may be rejected by financial institutions and payment processors for lack of commercial substance. Full commercial substance is not required under Panama's territorial tax regime when no local income is derived, but economic substance rules under Law 254 of 2021 may apply to licensed activities.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for non-licensed, light-asset e-commerce sales companies; risk is approximately 5% to 10% per year, primarily if tax filing inconsistencies, unusual payment processor transactional patterns, or money laundering red flags arise. Panama's territorial taxation reduces but does not eliminate inspection trigger from offshore-source business activity.

Pre-incorporation legal due diligence and anti-money laundering screening of UBO/shareholder

Registered agent service fee (first year mandatory representation)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Panama / Panamanian Embassy or Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official apostille and consular fee schedule

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Panama General Corporation Law (Ley 32 de 1927, as amended by Ley 5 de 2009), principally Articles 1-30 (incorporation, capital and share subscription) and Articles 50-71 (directors, officers and corporate governance)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry of Panama) - Sección Mercantil
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución / Acta Constitutiva (Public Incorporation Deed) executed before a Panamanian Notary and filed with the Mercantile Section of the Public Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; a nominal authorized capital (e.g., USD 10,000) is standard and no portion must be subscribed or escrowed at incorporation; fully or partially unpaid shares are lawful and paid up according to the board's subscription resolutions.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [NAME OF SOCIEDAD ANÓNIMA], S.A. By unanimous written consent of the Board of Directors under Law 32 of 1927, as amended: WHEREAS the corporation is registered in the Public Registry of Panama; RESOLVED, that the issuance and subscription of [number] ordinary shares to the initial shareholders is ratified; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office at [address], Panama, is adopted as the statutory domicile; RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is elected President, [Name] Secretary, and [Name] Treasurer until the next annual meeting; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the President is authorized to file regulatory documents, open bank accounts, and appoint agents; RESOLVED, that all actions already taken in the company's name are ratified. ADOPTED this [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Dirección de Registro de Personas Jurídicas (through a certified Panamanian attorney or notary)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Solicitud de Reserva de Nombre with up to three alternative Spanish-language corporate names; the Registry issues a certification of availability (visto bueno) within the statutory period. The reservation is valid for 30 days and must be renewed if the public deed is not filed in time.
required_dossiers: Notarized application for name reservation
Certified passport copy of each subscribing shareholder
Signed incorporation instructions from the registered agent or incorporating attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected or conflicts with an existing registration, the attorney shall submit the next priority alternative name or file a reconsideration request before the Registrar's General Directorate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Public Incorporation Deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública (Panamanian Notary Public) authorized by the Supreme Court of Justice of Panama, with drafting by a licensed Panamanian lawyer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Escritura Pública de Constitución / Acta Constitutiva containing the corporate name, registered office address, object clause covering manufacture of enamel badges and related merchandise (ISIC 3240), authorized capital structure, first directors and officers, and resident agent designation. All incorporators must appear before the notary in person or by notarized power of attorney to sign; the notary issues certified copies for registration.
required_dossiers: Valid passports or identity documents of incorporators
Name reservation certificate (visto bueno)
Draft articles of incorporation (Estatutos)
Acceptance letter of the resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any defect raised by the notary is cured by an addendum (adenda) to the deed; if a power-of-attorney deficiency is identified, a new notarized power of attorney must be obtained before signing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration at the Mercantile Section of the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Sección Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the first certified copy of the incorporation deed with the Mercantile Section, pay the applicable inscription and stamp fees, and obtain the registered mercantile entry (ficha / asiento). The registry verification covers statutory formalities, capital clause, object clause, and appointment of the resident agent.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the public deed issued by the notary
Proof of payment of registry fees and fiscal stamps
Power of attorney of the filing attorney
Acceptance document of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a defect notice (nota de defecto), cure each noted item in writing within 30 days and resubmit the corrected deed; appeal to the General Directorate if the defect is considered unwarranted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration (RUC) and Municipal Operating Notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; Alcaldía (Municipality) of the district where the industrial premises are located
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) by presenting the registered deed and identifying the legal representative; register the ISIC 3240 economic activity. Thereafter file the Aviso de Operación application with the competent Municipality and pay the annual municipal operating tax for the commercial and industrial premises.
required_dossiers: Registered incorporation deed and mercantile registration certificate
RUC application forms and legal representative identification
Lease agreement or title deed evidencing the industrial and registered premises
Municipal Aviso de Operación application form and payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI or Municipality questions the activity classification, file a written amendment (solicitud de modificación de actividad) with the supporting ISIC/CIIU description; any assessed municipal arrears may be challenged through the alcaldía's administrative review channel.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Governance Formalities and Corporate Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate officers, registered agent, and commercial banks receiving the corporate deposit and payout accounts for Etsy Direct Pay and Stripe
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or adopt the unanimous written consent approving the First Board Resolution; issue share certificates against subscriptions; appoint the president, secretary and treasurer; open a corporate bank account in Panama after the RUC and Aviso de Operación are in force, providing the complete KYC file to enable Etsy Direct Pay and Stripe payouts.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the registered incorporation deed
RUC certification and Aviso de Operación
Passport copies and signed KYC questionnaires of directors and officers
Corporate share certificates and first board resolution
Bank account opening forms and payment-rail declarations for Etsy Direct Pay and Stripe
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or payment processor requests enhanced due diligence, provide a notarized source-of-funds declaration and professional references; if officer appointments require registry annotation, file the corresponding officer-change form with the Mercantile Section.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Annual Franchise Tax Filing and Post-Formation Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Registro Público de Panamá, and the competent Municipality
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the annual corporate franchise tax (Tasa Única / flat fee) on or before the statutory due date and submit the corresponding income tax declaration under Panama's territorial taxation; maintain the registered agent, registered address, and municipal Aviso de Operación renewals, and update the Registry on any change of officers or address.
required_dossiers: RUC / NIT certificate
Annual franchise tax form and payment receipt
Financial records for the fiscal year
Municipal Aviso de Operación renewal form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late-filing surcharges are cured by voluntary payment and submission of corrected filings; first-time filers may request waiver of penalties under the regularization regime of the Panamanian Tax Procedure Code.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) - Dirección General de Industrias, coordinated with the municipal Aviso de Operación window
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación Industrial / Licencia Municipal de Operación (Municipal Operating License)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) - Dirección de Verificación del Desempeño Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría I - Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental Inicial (Initial Environmental Assessment) for low-emission micro-manufacturing workshops; exempt from a full Categoría II/III EIA where installed capacity and emissions remain below the thresholds of the national EIA regulations (Ley 41 de 1998 and Decreto Ejecutivo 123 de 2009, as amended).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Industrial wastewater must meet the national receiving-water quality standards of Panama: pH 6.0-9.0, biochemical oxygen demand, suspended solids, and oil and grease maximums; acidic etching baths and dyeing rinses containing heavy metals (Cu, Zn, Cd, Pb) must be pre-treated or disposed of through a licensed hazardous-waste operator; air emissions from enamel-curing ovens must comply with the applicable atmospheric emission standards and odor-control requirements; unusable enamel residue, metal scrap, and spent chemical containers must be classified, labeled, and transported by licensed hazardous-waste carriers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá (Panama Fire Department) fire-safety inspection and certificate covering fire suppression, egress, and alarms; municipal structural-load clearance for workshop furnaces and kilns; occupational health approval from the Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) for ventilation, machine guarding, and personal protective equipment; employer registration with the Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) for workers and workplace safety committee establishment where applicable.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; official electronic portal 'T@P - Trámite en Panamá' (https://www.tap.gob.pa/).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity first appoints a resident Panamanian agent and executes a public deed before a notary, which is filed with the Mercantile Registry of Panama. Upon registration, the entity must enroll in the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) through the DGI T@P portal; the RUC is the statutory tax identification number used for all ITBMS and income tax filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not operate a US-style check-the-box election; all Sociedades Anónimas are automatically taxed at entity level on Panama-source income only. Statutory elections are limited to specially applied regimes: Multinational Corporate Headquarters (SEM) under Law 41 of 2007, Panama Pacifico operations, free-zone operators, and the optional small taxpayer simplified regime for businesses with qualifying annual turnover thresholds established by the DGI.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto a la Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS) – Value Added Tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No statutory exemption threshold; registration is compulsory from the first taxable transfer, service, or importation in Panama. The DGI's small taxpayer simplified regime may apply to qualifying taxpayers below the administrative turnover threshold set by the DGI.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama's mandatory electronic invoicing regime requires authorized taxpayers to transmit invoices in real time to the DGI through the T@P platform or an accredited technological provider (PROV) before issuance; each validated invoice must include a QR code, Coded Unique Electronic Invoice Identifier (CUFIN), and the DGI clearance stamp. Non-compliant exporters are suspended from electronic issuance and may be excluded from zero-rating privileges.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods and offshore services qualify for the 0% ITBMS rate when the goods leave Panamanian customs territory permanently or the services are supplied to non-residents for consumption entirely abroad and are not related to Panamanian real property. The exporter must hold a valid RUC, be registered as an exporter with the DGI, and maintain documentary proof of the shipment and receipt of foreign proceeds.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Única de Aduanas, DUA) validated by the National Customs Authority of Panama
Bill of Lading or equivalent air/sea waybill demonstrating physical exit from Panamanian customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank payment evidence showing receipt of export proceeds from non-resident debtors
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI and the national customs authority cross-match export declarations, shipping records, and bank remittance evidence within the 180-day repatriation deadline. Deficient substantiation or untimely repatriation causes the zero rate to be clawed back and reclassified as taxable ITBMS at 7%, accruing late-payment interest, a statutory surcharge, and fines of up to twice the evaded tax. Repeated or fraudulent export zero-rating claims may additionally result in loss of the exporter registration and criminal tax-fraud prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP), established under Decree-Law 9 of 1998, is the sovereign banking supervisor; Panama has no central bank and Banco Nacional de Panamá functions solely as fiscal agent and governmental treasury counterpart of the State. The Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) administers fiscal policy but exercises no foreign-exchange control authority.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates a fully dollarized monetary system: the US dollar is legal tender and the balboa (PAB) is a 1:1 nominal unit of account with zero independent central-bank issuance. Current-account and capital-account convertibility is unrestricted; there are no exchange controls, no capital-movement authorizations, no repatriation restrictions for dividends, royalties or loan repayments, and no requirement to channel transactions through any central clearing system. The only statutory frictions are the AML reporting grid: threshold-based transaction and cash reports to the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF), and the 5% dividend withholding tax applicable to distributions funded by taxed Panamanian-source profits under the territorial income tax regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panamanian law contains no export-proceeds surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion ratio, no retention timeline, and no duty to repatriate foreign sales proceeds by any fixed date; export receivables may be retained indefinitely in USD or any foreign currency, either in Panama or abroad. The exporter is only required to maintain standard customs and tax traceability (commercial invoices, póliza de exportación, beneficiary declarations) and to satisfy routine UAF reporting thresholds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Current Account (Cuenta Corriente Empresarial); capital contribution credited to the same account because no statutory capital escrow account exists for a zero-minimum-capital S.A.
Operational USD Current Account with online corporate treasury and optional segregated sub-account for marketplace settlement sweeps.
Operational USD Current Account with multicurrency sub-ledger configuration (USD/EUR) for Etsy/Stripe receivables aggregation.
USD Operating Account with card-acquiring sub-accounts and trade-finance desk for commercial LC issuance.
Operational Corporate USD Account for juridical persons plus official-sector treasury and fiduciary services.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM as a supplementary collection rail, LOW as the primary treasury bank. Foreign digital EMIs (Wise Business, Airwallex, Mercury) and payment facilitators (Stripe, Etsy Direct Pay) can lawfully onboard a Panama-domiciled S.A. to aggregate USD/EUR settlements, but they are not licensed by the SBP, do not provide Panamanian banking secrecy protections, and cannot operate local clearing rails. The compliant treasury structure is therefore a two-tier rail: the foreign EMI/PSP functions solely as a pass-through collection account with automated nightly sweeps into the Tier 1 Panamanian bank, which remains the sole SBP-supervised repository of liquidity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is the de facto onboarding norm: the listed Tier 1 banks require the legal representative (registered Panamanian attorney) and ordinarily at least one director or beneficial owner to attend an in-branch KYC interview; remote opening is not generally offered. Where foreign directors cannot travel, banks will commonly accept a prior notarized and apostilled power of attorney combined with a recorded videoconference interview with the bank's designated Compliance Officer (Oficial de Cumplimiento) registered with the SBP/UAF; however, fully paperless remote onboarding without any physical nexus remains unavailable for a newly incorporated non-resident S.A.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque ultimate beneficial ownership: bearer-share heritage, nominee shareholders, or an undisclosed foreign principal financing the S.A.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the escritura pública (incorporation deed); Official Registry (Registro Público) certificate of current board and subscribed capital; completed Beneficial Owner Declaration under Law 23 of 2015 and Law 254 of 2021 (DGI Registry of Final Beneficiaries); notarized UBO chart; passports of all directors and UBOs; apostilled power of attorney for the legal representative; and a concise business rationale letter describing the ISIC 3240 hard enamel pin manufacturing and sales model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Substance mismatch: an S.A. with no payroll, inventory or local operating evidence claiming manufacturing/export activity in Panama.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Municipal Aviso de Operación (business licence) or statutory exemption certificate; registered-office lease or service agreement; outsourcing agreement(s) with the enamel-pin production workshop (domestic or offshore fabrication); purchase orders and order book; factory or product inspection records; first-year cash-flow projection with gross-margin build-up; payroll/CSS social-security filings where staff exist; and an HS-classification memorandum (typically 7117.19 or 7326.20 for metal lapel pins and badges).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Marketplace payment red flag: recurring incoming settlements identified as 'ETSY DIRECT PAY' or 'STRIPE ST' rather than named commercial counterparties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Payout reconciliation files and payout summaries from Etsy Direct Pay and Stripe; verified storefront URLs displaying the hard enamel lapel pins; order-by-order invoices and packing slips; export documentation (póliza de exportación, commercial invoices, customs broker receipts) evidencing physical product flow; and a written payment-flow narrative: marketplace → payment facilitator → Panamanian treasury account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sudden shareholder equity injection (USD 50,000–250,000) arriving before any trading history is recorded.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate resolution elevating the capital contribution; 12-month bank statements of the contributing shareholder; source-of-funds/source-of-wealth manifestation (sale agreements, salary records, dividend receipts); sworn opening balance sheet of the S.A.; RUC tax identification registration certificate; and a written explanation of working-capital requirements (inventory prepayments, freight deposits, supplier advances).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Concentrated outbound MT103 wires to high-density manufacturing jurisdictions (mainland China suppliers) triggering correspondent-bank sanctions screening.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Structured know-your-supplier file: factory business licence, site address and bank details; pro-forma invoices and purchase orders; export licences for enamel feedstock (zinc alloy blanks, liquid epoxy, plating compounds, packaging); Incoterms and letter-of-credit documentation; negative sanctions-screen results (OFAC/SDN, EU, UK consolidated lists); and a compliance memorandum confirming that no designated person, vessel or jurisdiction appears in the trade chain.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injections from non-resident shareholders should be executed by SWIFT MT103 or Fedwire credit to the S.A.'s USD account at the Panamanian Tier 1 bank, with the payment reference 'Aporte de capital accionistas / Capital Contribution' so the bank classifies the credit as paid-in equity rather than shareholder debt; this avoids any interest-withholding and thin-capitalization documentation burden under the territorial income tax regime. No prior SBP or MEF authorization is required; the receiving bank will record the board resolution, stock-registry entry and updated RUC in the client file, and will file applicable UAF threshold reports. Marketplace proceeds from Etsy Direct Pay and Stripe must never be labelled as capital: those credits arrive as trade receivables through ACH/SEPA/USD clearing and are reconciled against the platform payout reports.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound supplier settlements use the USD SWIFT rail (MT103) via each Panamanian bank's US correspondent network (CHIPS/Fedwire) for Chinese raw-material vendors; where suppliers cannot accept USD, the bank's treasury desk executes a USD/CNH spot conversion or the S.A. opens a Hong Kong CNY-denominated account. For high-value or repeat trade orders, the S.A. should employ SWIFT MT700 commercial letters of credit issued by the Panamanian bank and confirmed by the supplier's bank, supported by the documentary collection package (shipping documents, inspection certificates, bills of lading). Domestic USD disbursements (warehousing, local subcontractors, freight forwarders) clear same-day through the local ACH Panama interbank system, and Etsy/Stripe payouts in the reverse direction enter through the same USD clearing grid.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla OTC EUR/USD forwards and swaps (1–12 month tenors) documented under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with local Tier 1 bank treasury desks, hedging EUR-denominated Etsy/Stripe settlement flows into USD operating costs.

USD/CNH forwards and CNH nondeliverable forwards (NDFs) executed through the international sales desks of Banistmo, BAC International Bank, or Banco General to lock the USD cost of Chinese enamel-pin raw materials (zinc alloy blanks, enamel paints, plating, packaging).
Zero-cost collars and bought EUR/USD options to protect the gross margin of the retail marketplace channel without upfront premium leakage.
Cross-currency basis swaps (EUR/USD and USD/CNH) for long-dated committed sales or procurement contracts, collateralized under a negotiated Credit Support Annex to the ISDA Master Agreement.

No PAB/USD hedging instrument is required or available: the balboa is a 1:1 legal-tender shadow of the USD, so treasury risk is confined to third-currency cross pairs arising from platform settlement geography and suppliers' CNY invoicing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual franchise tax certificate and payment (Tasa Única Anual) for all Panamanian Sociedades Anónimas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; payment may be made through Banco Nacional de Panamá or authorized banks
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each 15 March, covering the preceding calendar year; deadline is strictly enforced for existing companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late surcharge of USD 50 or 10% of the tax (whichever is greater), plus accrued interest at the DGI statutory rate; failure to pay for three consecutive years triggers administrative strike-off from the Registro Público and loss of corporate legal capacity

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Panamanian S.A. with no Panamanian-source income and no commercial activity in Panama is not required to file audited financial statements. An independent audit is mandatory if the company conducts taxable activities in Panama and gross annual taxable revenue exceeds USD 1,000,000 or if the entity is listed or regulated; otherwise, an unaudited set of accounts prepared by a licensed accountant satisfies corporate record-keeping duties.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS as issued by the IASB for public-interest entities; Panama GAAP (normas de información financiera de Panamá, aligned with IFRS for SMEs) for ordinary private companies

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must hold a complete ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) register and at each calendar-year end circulate a written confirmation to directors requiring disclosure of any share transfers or changes in ownership. Transfers of shares must be reflected in the share transfer journal and approved by the board; the transfer instrument is subject to the Panama Stamp Tax at the statutory rate where the transfer has a Panamanian situs. Bearer shares remain immobilized under custody and cannot be transferred without written notification to the custodian. Where a transfer changes the UBO, the S.A. must update the UBO register within 30 days and ensure the registered agent's confirmation remains accurate before the annual franchise tax filing.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholders and Board Resolutions
Share Transfer Journal and Bearer Share Custody Records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 - USD 700 per year in the Panamanian regulated agent market, including registered office and statutory agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 - USD 5,000 for a standard small S.A. audit by an established Panamanian CPA firm when audited financials are required

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Panama applies a territorial corporate income tax. Only Panama-source income is taxable, and the headline 25% statutory rate applies only to taxable income exceeding B/.1,500,000; the first B/.1,500,000 of taxable income is taxed at 15%. No statutory income tax holiday or preferential export-manufacturing deduction is available for a standard Sociedad Anónima producing die-struck brass cloisonné enamel lapel pins, but legitimate direct costs, platform fees, shipping costs, and treaty-compliant foreign-source income exclusions may reduce the effective Panamanian tax burden. The effective rate is materially below the statutory headline when the company distributes goods through foreign fulfillment and maintains no Panama value-creating substance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 100 (Declaración Jurada de Impuesto Sobre la Renta – Personas Jurídicas), filed through the Sistema T@X electronic filing portal of the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of Panama's Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final corporate income tax return, plus quarterly advance income tax declarations on Formulario 103 and, for registered large taxpayers, monthly payment schedules.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within three months after the close of the taxable year. For calendar-year taxpayers, the annual Formulario 100 must be filed by 31 March of the following year. If a different fiscal year is authorized by the DGI, the return must be filed no later than three months after the authorized year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross Panama-source revenue from sales of enamel lapel pins, including sales processed through Etsy, Stripe, or other payment rails when the principal commercial decisions, invoicing, risk, or fulfillment management physically occur in Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the Panama S.A. conducts no Panamanian operational activity and title transfers outside Panama through foreign fulfillment centers, the corresponding revenue may be excluded as foreign-source income, but the exclusion must be supported by contracts, logistics records, invoices, and absence of Panama employees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross foreign-source income, including export sales generated by a foreign branch, foreign fulfillment partner, or a foreign permanent establishment of the Panama corporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter such income for informational reconciliation only and do not subject it to Panamanian tax. Attach a statement describing the foreign business operation, foreign bank flows, and relevant tax treaty or territoriality provisions if the operation is challenged by DGI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold directly attributable to die-struck brass pin blanks, cloisonné enamel colors, polishing compounds, molds or tooling, subcontract production, and direct labor allocated to the Panama-source sales.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate costs through consistent inventory and costing records. Non-resident-controlled companies must be able to reconcile purchases paid from Panama accounts with Etsy shipment volumes to prevent reclassification of disguised profit repatriation as deductible cost.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Opening and closing inventory adjustments for finished hard enamel pins, brass blanks, and packaging materials.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No field is exempt for non-resident shareholders; the corporation must maintain physical inventory count sheets and customs or shipping documentation. DGI may treat unexplained inventory differences as taxable Panama-source revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses, including Etsy transaction fees, Stripe payment processing fees, web platform costs, packaging, freight, professional fees, and Panama office overhead.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only expenses supported by valid invoices with RUC-tax ID numbers when applicable. Payments to related foreign entities above B/.100,000 should be accompanied by transfer pricing documentation to avoid disallowance and withholding recharacterization.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net income before legal loss carryforwards, computed as Panama-source gross revenue less Panama-allocable cost of sales and operating expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the computation produces a loss, the non-resident-owned S.A. must still file the return; a loss does not excuse filing. Losses may be evidenced and carried forward for up to five years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Application of prior-year net operating losses within the five-year carryforward period
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot use losses of the Panama S.A. against their home-country income, nor can the Panama S.A. absorb a parent's losses. Loss carryforward must be tracked separately by year and by Panama-source vs. foreign-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate Income Tax determined on the taxable base after loss carryforwards: 15% on the first B/.1,500,000 of taxable income and 25% on taxable income above B/.1,500,000.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute the tax from the Panama-source taxable amount only. Do not include tax on foreign Etsy sales. Attach a reconciliation for any prior quarterly prepayments and foreign tax credits claimed under a tax treaty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly advance tax payments and withholding tax credits applied against the final tax due.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident-owned Panama S.A. must make quarterly advance payments (Formulario 103) if it earns Panama-source income. Refund requests require a clean DGI compliance certificate and a sworn statement of foreign-source exclusion for all non-Panama revenue flows.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of Formulario 100 triggers a monthly surcharge of 10% on the unpaid tax due, maximum 100% of the tax, plus interest at the official rate. Additional DGI fines may apply for failure to include required annexes, sworn statements, or beneficial owner schedules. Continued non-filing can lead to automatic assessment, bank account embargo, and administrative dissolution of the Sociedad Anónima.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama levies a 10% dividend withholding tax on gross dividends paid, distributed, credited, or made available to resident and non-resident shareholders from Panama-source taxable profits. To invoke a double-taxation agreement, the recipient shareholder must present a valid Tax Residence Certificate issued by the relevant foreign tax authority, submit the certificate and a beneficial ownership declaration to the Panama paying corporation, and file the corresponding DGI treaty-relief application before the distribution is made. The paying S.A. preserves the required evidence in its corporate books for at least the prescriptive period; without a filed and approved application, the payer must withhold at the full 10% domestic rate. Note that Panama has no comprehensive income tax treaty with the United States, so Etsy shareholders resident in the United States generally remain subject to the 10% Panamanian dividend withholding on distributions of Panama-source earnings.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Panama's domestic withholding tax on royalties and interest remitted to nonresident beneficial owners is generally 12.5% when the payment is attributable to Panama-source income or used in Panama. Treaty rates, when applicable, usually reduce interest and royalty withholding to 10% or 5%, subject to a valid Tax Residence Certificate and beneficial ownership documentation; certain payments for services fully performed and consumed outside Panama may fall outside the territorial withholding net. Loans from related foreign shareholders should be documented with formal loan agreements, arm's-length interest rates, and transfer pricing support to prevent recharacterization of interest as dividend distributions.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: B/.2,000,000 (United States dollar equivalent) in aggregate related-party transactions during the prior fiscal year; above this threshold, the Panama S.A. must prepare and maintain transfer pricing documentation, including a Local File and, where group requirements apply, a Master File.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Regulations (Law 70 of 2019 and implementing decrees) apply to Panama legal entities carrying out relevant activities such as distribution, logistics, agency, headquarters services, financing, leasing, and intellectual property holding. A Sociedad Anónima that derives foreign Etsy revenue but maintains no physical office, no employees, no independent corporate records, and no genuine Panamanian decision-making will be treated as a shell arrangement and may be subject to DGI reconstruction of Panama-source income, forfeiture of treaty benefits, and administrative sanctioning. Even where core manufacturing of hard enamel lapel pins occurs abroad, the Panama entity must demonstrate economic substance commensurate with its contractual function, assets, and risks if it books revenue or holds the trademark, tooling, and Etsy seller account.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion Through False Territorial Allocation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A Panama S.A. books all Etsy, Stripe, and PayPal receipts as foreign-source income while orders are accepted, invoiced, or fulfilled from Panama; or it operates from Panama but shifts margins to a related foreign shell without any transfer pricing study.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The DGI may re-determine taxable income under normal 15%/25% rates, apply the full unpaid tax plus monthly default interest, impose a late-payment surcharge up to 100% of the tax, and refer the taxpayer to criminal tax evasion proceedings. Administrative fines may reach tens of thousands of balboas, and repeated false returns can lead to cancellation of the RUC number.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false territorial-source returns, maintain hidden payment rails, or cause the corporation to underreport Panama-source revenue lose the protection of the corporate entity. The DGI and courts may pierce the corporate veil, order civil restitution of omitted taxes, freeze personal bank accounts, impose a travel ban (impedimento de salida), and convict responsible directors or beneficial owners of tax fraud with imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Sociedad Anónima holds the Etsy seller account and payment collection mandate but has no Panamanian business substance, no registered beneficial owner, no annual meeting minutes, no separate accounting, and no operational capacity. It is administered solely by a nominee agent and never files Formulario 100 or a beneficial ownership declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Registro Público may suspend corporate rights, the financial system may close its bank accounts, and the DGI may assess all proceeds as Panama-source through anti-abuse rules. Fines for failure to file beneficial ownership and economic substance declarations can reach B/.50,000 or more, and chronic inactivity can lead to cancellation of the corporate registrations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors, resident agents, and beneficial owners acting as the straw controllers can be held jointly and severally liable for unpaid corporate tax and AML fines. Courts in Panama have imposed civil restitution, asset embargos, travel restrictions, and disqualification from acting as directors of any Panama corporation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering and AML Reporting Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Collecting hard enamel lapel pin sales through the Panama S.A. using Etsy/Stripe proceeds while masking the identity of the true beneficial owner, accepting third-party payments, or structuring cash transactions to avoid Panama reporting thresholds; the underlying merchandise is also used to launder proceeds of infringing intellectual property or fraudulent vendor schemes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Panama's AML Law 23 of 2015 and regulations of the Financial Analysis Unit (UAF) provide substantial monetary penalties, seizure of funds, and criminal liability. Penalties can range from B/.100,000 to B/.1,000,000 depending on gravity; convicted persons may face imprisonment and permanent disqualification from regulated financial activities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is set aside for persons who knowingly use the Panama S.A. to receive dirty funds. Directors, shareholders, payment-rail administrators, and resident agents can be named as investigation subjects and face forfeiture of personal assets, travel bans, civil suits for restitution, and prison sentences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Corporate Income Tax Return and Dividend Withholding
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The S.A. actively receives Etsy and Stripe revenue through Panama-controlled channels but fails to file the annual Formulario 100, fails to make quarterly advance income tax payments, and distributes profits to shareholders without withholding the 10% dividend tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI will issue an automatic assessment based on available information, add a monthly surcharge of 10% and default interest, and may embargo bank accounts in custody of the Etsy/Stripe settlement accounts. Penalties for failure to withhold dividend tax are assessed on the payer, and dividends are treated as effectively distributed if the corporation holds undistributed profits without credible business justification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers responsible for deciding not to file, not to withhold, or not to disburse quarterly prepayments become personally liable for the withheld amounts, penalties, and defrauded tax. The DGI may pursue the individuals through the fiscal courts, request preventive embargo orders, and obtain travel bans restricting departure from Panama.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Panama S.A. buys, sells, or licenses materials and payment-rail rights to related factories, brand-holding entities, or a foreign parent at non-arm's-length prices and fails to prepare and submit the required transfer pricing Local File after exceeding the B/.2,000,000 related-party threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The DGI may adjust the taxable base to the arm's-length price, apply valuation and documentation penalties, and deny deductions for undocumented intercompany invoices. Penalties are calculated on the adjusted tax difference and can in egregious cases reach 20% to 40% of the tax adjustment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors signing the intercompany contracts and certifying transfer pricing returns are personally exposed to penalty assessment when they have knowingly selected an unrealistic methodology or suppressed required documentation. The relevant officers may also be subjected to criminal referral for fiscal fraud and curtailment of their right to leave Panama pending resolution.
